verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe supervised and reinforcement fine-tuning on your own existing SFT datasets, with Fireworks handling the GPUs and you keeping the weights. They also document deploying the trained LoRA on the same platform through live merge or multi-LoRA, using a single firectl command, and serving fine-tuned models at base-model prices. A community user's hands-on SFT run on gpt-oss-20b independently corroborates the training half. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of serving the fine-tuned result, and an explicit list of which base models support fine-tuning.
